mapper.sql: r.id, r.paper_id, r.student_id, r.start_time, r.submit_time, r.score, r.correct_count, r.total_count, r.status, r.is_timeout, r.created_at, r.updated_at, p.title AS paper_title, p.subject AS paper_subject, p.total_score AS paper_total_score, p.pass_score AS pass_score, p.duration_minutes AS duration_minutes, u.nickname AS student_nickname, u.username AS student_username
FROM exam_record r JOIN exam_paper p ON r.paper_id = p.id LEFT JOIN `user` u ON r.student_id = u.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exam_record (paper_id, student_id, start_time, submit_time, score, correct_count, total_count, status, is_timeout, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{paperId}, #{studentId}, #{startTime}, #{submitTime}, #{score}, #{correctCount}, #{totalCount}, #{status}, #{timeout}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE exam_record SET status = 'SUBMITTED', submit_time = NOW(), score = #{score}, correct_count = #{correctCount}, total_count = #{totalCount}, is_timeout = #{timeout}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ONGOING'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.score >= #{passScore} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pass_count, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(r.score), 1), 0) AS avg_score, COALESCE(MAX(r.score), 0) AS max_score, COALESCE(MIN(r.score), 0) AS min_score FROM exam_record r WHERE r.paper_id = #{paperId} AND r.status = 'SUBMITTED'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.score >= p.pass_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pass_count, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(r.score), 1), 0) AS avg_score, COALESCE(MAX(r.score), 0) AS max_score, COALESCE(MIN(r.score), 0) AS min_score FROM exam_record r JOIN exam_paper p ON r.paper_id = p.id WHERE r.student_id = #{studentId} AND r.status = 'SUBMITTED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_record r WHERE r.paper_id = #{paperId}
